definitions.explanation: Something that turned out badly, or, as an insult, a person regarded as useless or a disappointment.

examples.japanese: {出来損|できそこ}ない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出来損|できそこ}ないだ。
examples.english: This piece of work is a failure.

examples.japanese: 「⟦お{前|まえ}→お前：02533_omae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出来損|できそこ}ないだ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}てなかった→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Having grown up being told "You're a good-for-nothing," he found it hard to have any confidence.

notes:
The noun of {出来損|できそこ}なう (to turn out badly): {出来|でき}る + ⟦{損|そこ}なう→損なう：18061_sokonau⟧ (to fail at).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出来損|できそこ}ない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: a botched ~, a failed ~
- {出来損|できそこ}ない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧: a good-for-nothing son

WATCH OUT:
- Said of a person, it is a harsh insult. For a thing, {失敗作|しっぱいさく} (a failed piece of work) is the neutral word.
